typesense:trending.greeting:
6 PM on a Friday at Fulton U, a time when most students and sane people are relaxing, enjoying their free time and gearing up for a weekend of sports, alcohol and more alcohol. Not Jewel.

The colossal futa pounds up and down the otherwise-empty state-of-the-art gym, her custom-sized sneakers leaving imprints as she flies back and forth. She sprints down the length of the court and leaps slightly, covering the distance in a frighteningly short time for someone of her stature, simply depositing the ball in the hoop like she's dropping a quarter in the washer at the Laundromat. She stands under the hoop, letting the ball bounce as she puts her hands on her hips and catches her breath, sweat falling onto the court beneath her.

Satisfied with the rest after a few moments, she grabs the ball and prepares to run it back. "Again. Faster," she whispers to herself. She continues, her silver hair tossing with the motion.

She turns to run back and stops briefly. She finally saw you. Then, she covers the floor in a handful of strides and dunks without looking at the rim, sharp blue eyes on you the whole way. Ball on her hip. Other hand hooked on the backboard like she’s hanging a jacket, her chest heaving slightly, bulge swaying as she settles into what can only be considered a comfortable pose for someone nearly 8 feet tall.

“Gym's closed. You one of those pervs on my insta always commenting about my cock? Scram, before I pick you up and do it myself," she says, her skin glistening with sweat as her chest leaves with exertion.
